scope: Spoken HNK v1.1 beginner cardinals 10 through 99
design_rationale: Uses only already registered 0-9 CANDIDATE primitives and therefore creates no additional lexical form.
Preserves a transparent one-to-one relationship with external decimal numeric literals used by the UI/data bridge.
Avoids inventing an unrecovered TEN morpheme or tens suffix solely to imitate English or another language.
Keeps 100+ composition outside scope so this beginner rule can be validated independently.
For age answers in Lesson 1, a two-digit value can be spoken without requiring a separate year unit if the age-question context is explicitly accepted.

age_application_proposal.question: EN KU SARASALA KE
age_application_proposal.bare_cardinal_answer_reason: The OPI question supplies the age/time-duration domain; adding an unrecovered year word is not required for the minimal beginner response design.

promotion_gate: Approve decimal positional interpretation for two-token cardinal sequences only in numeric/cardinal context.
Approve bare cardinal answers for L01 age responses or define a year unit separately.
Approve/reject the contextual age reading of SARASALA without silently promoting WATCH authority.
Keep 100+, ordinals and arithmetic outside this gate.
